headline: Opposition urges parties to block delimitation bills, warns democracy at risk
hook: Lok Sabha’s opposition chief calls the delimitation push a threat to democracy.
what: The Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha addressed Gen Z, asking all parties, even those in the NDA, to oppose the Centre’s delimitation proposals. In a meeting, the opposition bloc also discussed the positions of NCP‑SP and DMK.
why: Young voters need to understand how changes to constituency boundaries can affect representation, so staying informed and voicing opinions matters.

beats.title: DEMOCRACY AT RISK?
beats.en: The opposition chief says the delimitation push could endanger our democracy.
beats.ml: Opposition chief പറയുന്നത് delimitation push നമ്മുടെ ജനാധിപത്യം അപകടത്തിലാക്കാമെന്ന്.

beats.title: BUT ACTUALLY...
beats.en: But actually, delimitation is just redrawing constituency maps, not a coup.
beats.ml: പക്ഷേ, delimitation എന്നത് constituency മാപ്പുകൾ പുനഃരേഖപ്പെടുത്തുന്നതാണ്, ഒരു കൂപ്പ് അല്ല.

beats.title: WHAT IS DELIMITATION?
beats.en: Delimitation means adjusting the boundaries of Lok Sabha seats based on population changes.
beats.ml: Delimitation എന്നത് ജനസംഖ്യ മാറ്റം അനുസരിച്ച് Lok Sabha സീറ്റുകളുടെ അതിർത്തികൾ പുനഃക്രമീകരിക്കുകയാണ്.

beats.title: CALL TO GEN Z
beats.en: The Leader of Opposition addressed Gen Z directly, urging every party, even those in the NDA, to vote against the bills.
beats.ml: Leader of Opposition Gen Z-നെ നേരിട്ട് അഭിസംബോധന ചെയ്തു, NDA-യിലുള്ള പാർട്ടികളുൾപ്പെടെ എല്ലാ പാർട്ടികളെയും ഈ ബില്ലുകൾക്കെതിരെ വോട്ട് ചെയ്യാൻ ആവശ്യപ്പെട്ടു.

beats.title: PARTY STANCES
beats.en: In the meeting they also mapped where NCP‑SP and DMK stand on the proposals.
beats.ml: അവരുടെ മീറ്റിംഗിൽ NCP‑SP, DMK എന്നിവയുടെ സ്ഥാനങ്ങൾ എവിടെയെന്ന് കൂടി ചർച്ച ചെയ്തു.

beats.title: WHY IT MATTERS
beats.en: Because shifting boundaries can change who represents you, staying informed and speaking up is crucial for your future.
beats.ml: അതിർത്തികൾ മാറ്റുന്നത് നിങ്ങളുടെ പ്രതിനിധി ആരാകും എന്നത് മാറ്റാം, അതിനാൽ അറിയുകയും നിങ്ങളുടെ അഭിപ്രായം പറയുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നത് നിങ്ങളുടെ ഭാവിക്ക് അത്യാവശ്യമാണ്.

headline: Eight dead, including seven women, after vehicle plunges in Uttarakhand gorge
hook: A tragic crash in the hills leaves eight dead, most of them women.
what: A vehicle carrying twelve people fell into a 300‑metre gorge in Pauri, Uttarakhand. Eight people died, including seven women, and the driver was also among the dead. Police and SDRF teams have recovered the bodies and are conducting rescue operations.
why: Travel in mountainous areas can be risky, especially during monsoon season. Stay updated on weather alerts and avoid risky routes.

headline: ‘We the Leaders’ backs new delimitation plan

what: The organization ‘We the Leaders’ has expressed support for the recently announced delimitation proposal. The group said it welcomes the changes aimed at redefining electoral boundaries.

beats.title: WHY CARE?
beats.en: Knowing the new map helps you see where your vote counts and how you can shape the future.

headline: Need 9‑10% raise to beat India’s inflation
hook: Your next pay bump could decide if your savings grow or shrink
what: Indian workers require roughly a 9‑10% yearly salary increase to keep up with rising prices. Higher living costs are eating into savings, so experts suggest directing part of any raise into mutual‑fund SIPs and long‑term goals.
why: For young earners, investing the extra amount helps protect buying power. Instead of just spending the raise, consider feeding it into systematic investment plans.

headline: Forum says Delimitation Bill sidelines minorities in UP
hook: A rights group warns the new bill could mute minority voices.
what: India Against Unfair Delimitation claims the BJP plans to redraw constituency borders to fit a majoritarian agenda. The group says this could render minority votes ineffective in Uttar Pradesh and other regions.
why: If true, the changes could affect how young voters from minority communities are represented. Stay informed and watch upcoming electoral reforms.

beats.en: But actually, the Delimitation Bill is about redrawing constituency borders.

beats.ml: ഇന്ത്യ അഗെയിന്‍സ് അണ്‍ഫെയര്‍ ഡെലിമിറ്റേഷന്‍ പറയുന്നു, ബി.ജെ.പി. മേജോറിറ്റേറിയന്‍ അജണ്ടയ്ക്കായി മാപ്പ് മാറ്റാന്‍ ശ്രമിക്കുന്നു.

beats.en: If the borders shift, minority votes could become ineffective in UP and nearby states.
beats.ml: അറ്റംമാറിയാല്‍, ന്യൂനപക്ഷ വോട്ടുകള്‍ ഉപ്പറ പ്രദേശത്തും ചുറ്റുമുള്ള സംസ്ഥാനങ്ങളിലും ഫലപ്രദമല്ലാതാകും.

beats.title: WHY IT MATTERS
beats.en: For you, that means your voice might not count in the next election – stay informed.
beats.ml: ഇത് നിങ്ങള്‍ക്ക്‌ അര്‍ത്ഥമാക്കുന്നത്, അടുത്ത തിരഞ്ഞെടുപ്പില്‍ നിങ്ങളുടെ ശബ്ദം കണക്കാക്കപ്പെടാതെ പോകാം – വിവരത്തില്‍ നില്‍ക്കൂ.

headline: Ramayana Part 1 Hits ₹1,800 cr, Sets $30 m NA Record
hook: The epic is now India's third‑biggest film ever.
what: On its 23rd day, the Ranbir Kapoor‑led ‘Ramayana Part 1’ grossed over ₹1,800 crore worldwide and earned $30 million in North America, a new record. It also surpassed the opening‑day earnings of ‘Yeh Prem Mol Liya’ and moved past Baahubali 2 to rank third among Indian movies.
why: Crossing the ₹1,000 crore mark in India makes it the first non‑sequel to do so, showing huge teen interest in big‑budget mythological sagas; fans can expect more releases in the franchise.
